# Piwik PRO

> Piwik PRO is a privacy-focused analytics and data activation platform for organizations that need reliable behavioral data, strong data control, privacy compliance and the ability to turn insights into marketing actions.

Piwik PRO combines four integrated modules: Analytics, Tag Manager, Data Activation and Consent Management. The platform supports web and mobile analytics, customer journey analysis, privacy-conscious data collection, data activation, integrations and controlled access to raw data.

Piwik PRO is designed for organizations with demanding privacy, security and data-governance requirements, including healthcare, financial services, energy and utilities, government and the public sector.

Important notes:

- Piwik PRO currently offers Business and Enterprise plans. The former free Core plan is no longer part of the current offer.
- Piwik PRO MCP (beta) lets users get answers from their analytics data through AI assistants without building reports.
- For pricing, plan availability, limits and commercial packaging, use the pricing page.
- For implementation details, use the Help Center and developer documentation rather than marketing pages.
- Product capabilities, pricing, regulations and content change over time. Verify time-sensitive claims against the current linked page before presenting them as current facts.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-26

## Product

- [Platform overview](https://piwik.pro/platform/): How the Analytics, Tag Manager, Data Activation and Consent Management modules work together.
- [Analytics](https://piwik.pro/web-analytics/): Web and mobile analytics, customer journey analysis and reporting.
- [Product analytics](https://piwik.pro/product-analytics/): Analytics for product teams.
- [Tag Manager](https://piwik.pro/tag-manager/): Tag management for deploying and controlling tracking and marketing tags.
- [Server-side tracking and tagging](https://piwik.pro/server-side-tracking-tagging/): Server-side data collection and tag management.
- [Data Activation](https://piwik.pro/data-activation/): Turning behavioral data into audiences and marketing actions.
- [Consent Management](https://piwik.pro/gdpr-consent-manager/): Collecting and managing visitor consent for privacy compliance.
- [Integrations](https://piwik.pro/integrations/): Supported integrations with other platforms and tools.
- [AI-ready data](https://piwik.pro/ai-ready-data/): Preparing analytics data for use with AI tools.
- [Piwik PRO MCP (beta)](https://piwik.pro/blog/piwik-pro-now-connects-with-mcp/): Announcement of the MCP connection for querying analytics data through AI assistants.
- [Professional services](https://piwik.pro/services/): Implementation and consulting services from Piwik PRO.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://piwik.pro/pricing/): Current plans, plan comparison, limits and commercial packaging.
- [Business plan](https://piwik.pro/business-plan/): Details of the Business plan.
- [Business vs. Enterprise](https://piwik.pro/business-vs-enterprise/): Differences between the Business and Enterprise plans.

## Privacy, security and compliance

- [Privacy and security](https://piwik.pro/privacy-security/): How Piwik PRO handles data security and privacy.
- [Privacy compliance](https://piwik.pro/privacy-compliance/): How the platform supports compliance with privacy regulations.

## Industries

- [Healthcare and HIPAA](https://piwik.pro/hipaa/): Analytics for healthcare organizations subject to HIPAA.
- [Banking and financial services](https://piwik.pro/analytics-for-banking-financial-services/): Analytics for banks and financial institutions.
- [Energy and utilities](https://piwik.pro/analytics-for-energy-utilities/): Analytics for energy and utility companies.
- [Government and public sector](https://piwik.pro/analytics-for-governments-the-public-sector/): Analytics for government and public-sector organizations.
- [Ecommerce](https://piwik.pro/ecommerce-analytics/): Analytics for online stores.

## Switching from other tools

- [Switch from Google Analytics](https://piwik.pro/ga4-knowledge-hub/): GA4 knowledge hub and guidance on moving from Google Analytics.
- [Switch from Matomo](https://piwik.pro/switch-from-matomo/): Guidance on moving from Matomo.

## Documentation

- [Help Center](https://help.piwik.pro/): Product documentation and implementation guides.
- [Developers and API](https://developers.piwik.pro/): Developer documentation and API reference.
- [Changelog](https://developers.piwik.pro/changelog/): Product release notes.
- [Piwik PRO Academy](https://academy.piwik.pro/): Training courses for Piwik PRO users.
- [Community forum](https://community.piwik.pro/): User questions and discussion.

## Customer stories

- [Success stories](https://piwik.pro/success-stories/): Index of customer case studies.
- [Partner spotlights](https://piwik.pro/partner-spotlight/): Index of partner case studies.
- [Terveystalo](https://piwik.pro/success-stories/terveystalo/): Customer story.
- [Wien Energie](https://piwik.pro/success-stories/wien-energie/): Customer story.
- [Rochester Regional Health](https://piwik.pro/success-stories/rochester-regional-health/): Customer story.
- [Hopkins Agency](https://piwik.pro/partner-spotlight/how-hopkins-agency-quadrupled-campaign-traffic/): Partner story on how the agency quadrupled campaign traffic.

## Optional

- [Blog](https://piwik.pro/blog/): Articles on analytics, privacy and compliance. Use the index for the latest posts.
- [Recovering lost conversions without compliance risk](https://piwik.pro/blog/funnel-recovery-how-to-recover-lost-conversions/): Article on funnel recovery.
- [HIPAA violations and fines](https://piwik.pro/blog/hipaa-violations-and-fines/): What healthcare organizations need to know.
- [EDPB data anonymization guidelines](https://piwik.pro/blog/edpb-data-anonymization-guidelines/): What the guidelines mean for analytics data.
- [What is protected health information (PHI)?](https://piwik.pro/blog/what-is-protected-health-information-phi/): Guide for healthcare marketers.
- [Healthcare website tracking report 2026](https://piwik.pro/blog/healthcare-website-tracking-report-2026-blog-post/): Study of 59 hospital websites and tracking after opt-out.
- [Glossary](https://piwik.pro/glossary/): Definitions of analytics, privacy, marketing technology and compliance terms.
- [Server-side vs. client-side tracking](https://piwik.pro/glossary/server-side-tracking/): Glossary entry.
- [Sessions](https://piwik.pro/glossary/sessions/): Glossary entry.
- [Data layer](https://piwik.pro/glossary/data-layer/): Glossary entry.
- [Direct traffic](https://piwik.pro/glossary/direct-traffic/): Glossary entry.
- [Visitor](https://piwik.pro/glossary/visitor/): Glossary entry.
- [Content library](https://piwik.pro/resources/): Guides, reports and other resources.
- [Webinars](https://piwik.pro/webinars/): Recorded and upcoming webinars.
- [Events](https://piwik.pro/events/): Upcoming events.
- [Sitemap](https://piwik.pro/sitemap/): Full list of website pages.

<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center" id="h-frequently-asked-questions">Frequently asked questions</h2>



<div class="wp-block-group is-style-default is-layout-constrained wp-container-core-group-is-layout-2dffda1c wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<details class="wp-block-details is-style-faq is-layout-flow wp-block-details-is-layout-flow"><summary>We’re already using Google Analytics. Why switch?</summary>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Google does not offer a BAA for Google Analytics, which limits its use where PHI may be disclosed to Google. The use of third-party tracking technologies, including Google Analytics, has also attracted regulatory scrutiny in healthcare. Piwik PRO provides analytics and attribution capabilities within an environment designed to support regulated healthcare use cases, including BAA-covered deployments.</p>
</details>



<details class="wp-block-details is-style-faq is-layout-flow wp-block-details-is-layout-flow"><summary>We’re already using another analytics tool. Why switch?</summary>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Many analytics tools don’t capture the full customer journey, or they lose accuracy along the way, leaving marketing teams unable to make informed, confident decisions. Piwik PRO closes that gap with a platform that meets privacy requirements out of the box and delivers data you can trust. On top of that, you get an easy-to-use interface and real value for money.</p>
</details>



<details class="wp-block-details is-style-faq is-layout-flow wp-block-details-is-layout-flow"><summary>Does Piwik PRO work with the tools we already use?</summary>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. Piwik PRO includes a built-in Tag Manager that can be covered under the same BAA as Analytics, reducing the need for a separate tag-management service in your HIPAA-regulated setup.</p>
</details>



<details class="wp-block-details is-style-faq is-layout-flow wp-block-details-is-layout-flow"><summary>Where is our data stored?</summary>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Your covered Piwik PRO data is stored in the US under the hosting option agreed for your deployment. Piwik PRO processes this data on your behalf under the BAA, while you retain control over how the service is configured and used.</p>
</details>



<details class="wp-block-details is-style-faq is-layout-flow wp-block-details-is-layout-flow"><summary>How long does implementation take?</summary>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Most organizations are operational within a few days. For simple use cases – basic aggregated stats, goal conversions, and a few custom events – you could be up and running in hours. If your use case involves PHI, the relevant services can process it under a signed BAA, subject to appropriate customer configuration and use.</p>
</details>



<details class="wp-block-details is-style-faq is-layout-flow wp-block-details-is-layout-flow"><summary>Do we need technical resources to manage it day-to-day?</summary>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">No. Piwik PRO is built for marketers to run day-to-day, without needing a developer on hand. Your IT team reviews and approves the architecture up front, and from there, your marketing team owns the platform – backed by dedicated implementation support and training if you need it.</p>
</details>



<details class="wp-block-details is-style-faq is-layout-flow wp-block-details-is-layout-flow"><summary>Can Piwik PRO be configured for HIPAA compliance?</summary>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. Piwik PRO can be configured to support your organization’s HIPAA requirements, with an applicable BAA, AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit, as well as data residency controls.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Under a signed BAA, Piwik PRO can process PHI within the covered services, subject to your HIPAA obligations and how you configure and use the platform.You control access for your users. Compliance is a shared responsibility: we provide the infrastructure and safeguards, and you configure the platform to match your PHI handling needs.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Site, app, and module-level permissions let you control who can access the collected data, including PHI. Audit logs help you review relevant user and administrative activity. Privacy and data minimization settings options let you disable IP collection and other identifiers for an extra layer of protection.</p>
</details>



<details class="wp-block-details is-style-faq is-layout-flow wp-block-details-is-layout-flow"><summary>Does using Piwik PRO ensure my organization’s HIPAA compliance?</summary>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Not automatically. Piwik PRO is designed to support your organization’s HIPAA compliance efforts, but using the platform, even under a BAA with us, does not by itself make your organization compliant. You remain responsible for maintaining an appropriate compliance program and ensuring that your configuration, internal processes, and use of Piwik PRO align with your obligations under HIPAA.</p>
</details>



<details class="wp-block-details is-style-faq is-layout-flow wp-block-details-is-layout-flow"><summary>What is a BAA and why does it matter?</summary>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">A Business Associate Agreement (BAA) is generally required under HIPAA when a service provider creates, receives, maintains or transmits PHI on behalf of a covered entity or Business Associate. Where required, operating without a BAA can create HIPAA compliance risk. Piwik PRO enters into a BAA before PHI is disclosed to or processed by Piwik PRO, subject to the applicable offering and contracting process.</p>
</details>



<details class="wp-block-details is-style-faq is-layout-flow wp-block-details-is-layout-flow"><summary><strong>Can Piwik PRO support patient-journey analytics in a HIPAA-regulated environment?</strong></summary>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Piwik PRO can be configured to measure traffic sources, campaign performance and conversion events, including appointment-booking events, while supporting your HIPAA compliance program. Customers remain responsible for deciding what data may be collected and how the platform is configured.</p>
</details>
